content.short: Each of these unique Limited Edition designs is being minted on the Cardano Blockchain as a Non Fungible Token (NFT).
content.description: CardanoKidz is an early Cardano NFT collectible project built around limited-edition character designs. The collection celebrates Cardano figures, community culture, and the early energy of NFTs on the chain. Each design is minted as a non-fungible token, giving collectors ownership of a small piece of Cardano NFT history. The project is often framed as one of the early collectible experiments in the ecosystem, with its appeal coming from nostalgia, character art, and Cardano community identity.
